verdicts.fieldOrGeometry: AcroForm text field "listed charges", the writable run inside the court's agency-sealing paragraph
verdicts.observed: The participant's full legal name is printed inside the ORDER paragraph. The page reads: "The Kentucky State Police and other following agencies listed below are hereby ordered to seal any records in their custody regarding the above-named Defendant and above-listed charge(s):" followed on the next line by "Jordan Avery Reyes". The map binds {"field":"listed charges","class":"participant","factId":"participant.full_legal_name","factBasis":"printed_label","effectiveLabel":"their custody regarding the above-named Defendant and above-"} — the label match is against the court's own order sentence, so the participant name lands in the space where the agencies ordered to seal are listed.
verdicts.required: The agency list inside the order is court and agency space and must be blank of participant-derived content. "listed charges" must not receive participant.full_legal_name; if it is to be written at all it holds charge text, and on an order the participant does not supply it.
verdicts.why: Recorded against the exact bytes at the reviewed base; see observed.
verdicts.smallestCorrection: Drop the "listed charges" binding from production-field-map.json, or exclude printed_label matches whose effectiveLabel falls inside a court-owned decision or agency paragraph, then re-render this family and refresh the sidecar. The Case No, Defendant and Defendants Birthdate bindings are correct and unaffected.

verdicts.fieldOrGeometry: AcroForm choice field "3 County Dropdown" (/Ch, 121 options), rect [452.0, 692.8, 576.0, 706.2]
verdicts.observed: A single 791-glyph run is drawn at y1=692.2 spanning x=[452.0..507.6] — starting at the rect left edge but below its lower bound, so the County rule line clips it to an illegible smear. The run is the field's entire /Opt list (all 120 Kentucky counties plus the blank option) concatenated: 121 options totalling 792 characters against 791 glyphs drawn. The field's value /V is " ", so nothing is selected. This artifact is byte-identical to the historically frozen hash, so the family was never re-rendered and the original objection reproduces exactly.
verdicts.required: A /Ch field must flatten to its selected value only, drawn once, legibly, inside the widget rect. With /V = " " the County region must render blank, as the blank source does.
verdicts.why: Recorded against the exact bytes at the reviewed base; see observed.
verdicts.smallestCorrection: In the /Ch flatten path draw /V rather than the /Opt list and skip the draw when /V is empty or whitespace; then re-render this family — it is the one family in this shard that the correction wave never re-rendered. The 1 Case Number binding is correct and unaffected.
